swimming_pool.evidence: The blue pool at the top center lies outside the yellow outline, on the neighboring lot. No pool is visible inside the outline.

signals.notes: The house has a reddish-brown shingle roof with some fading and uneven color, and an asphalt driveway runs to the right of the house. Heavy tree canopy covers the north and east parts of the lot, and the neighbor's pool outside the outline should not be credited to this property.
